'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Kevin Shannon LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
